Riverside Endoscopy Unit (fictional)
Upper Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Report
Date of service: 2026-10-30
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
UPPER ENDOSCOPY
The gastroscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum.
Lesion 1 - gastric body: a 5 mm sessile polyp was removed with cold forceps.
COLONOSCOPY
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the ileocecal valve was identified.
Lesion 1 - sigmoid colon: an 8 mm sessile polyp was removed with a cold snare.
No forceps biopsy was taken from Lesion 1.
Impression: one gastric polyp and one sigmoid polyp removed.
